estimand: climate news exposure x pro-environmental intention -> first birth

notes: TABLE 2 EXTRACTED. RR 0.38, p<0.01, n=108185. NO CI OR SE IS REPORTED — the table gives stars only, so this cannot enter a pool. TWO SUBSTANTIVE FLAGS. (1) THE MAIN EFFECT IS NULL: high climate-news exposure alone is 0.90 (H1, n.s.) and 1.04-1.05 in H2/H3. The entire result is the interaction term. (2) 0.38 IS AN INTERACTION COEFFICIENT, and the paper interprets it directly as the subgroup effect ('a reduction of roughly 62% relative to the reference group'). Multiplying the components gives roughly 1.04 x 1.37 x 0.38 = 0.54, not 0.38, so the headline 62% may conflate a ratio-of-ratios with a subgroup probability. Flagged needs_pi rather than asserted as an error — their model may be parameterised differently — but the chapter must not repeat the 62% unchecked. (3) The moderator is 'Environmental Attitude [Want to do more]', an environmental ASPIRATION measure, i.e. the Wall 1 construct: the D.3.b-shaped effect here exists only conditional on a D.1.a-type variable.
